module "P_MeshKeys.dsp"

product 0 PassPipeline "P_MeshKeys"
  pipeline order=0 injection=BeforePostProcess views=Game|Editor requires=- enabled=-
  buffer "Depth" Depth32 resolution=Render scale=1 (inferred) clear=(0, 0, 0, 0) mips=1
  buffer "Data" RG16F resolution=Render scale=1 (inferred) clear=(0, 0, 0, 0) mips=1
  pass "Draw" mesh injection=BeforeBasePass
    material "M_Data" object=""
    filter Layer(Highlight)
    mesh mode=OwnOrOverride depth=Own(Depth) cull=Front blend=AlphaBlend usage=StaticMesh|SplineMesh|GeometryCache nanite=AssignStencil assign=200 naniteValue=(0.5, 0.25, 0, 1)
    write Output1 = Data
